programme.title: Mark Lawson Talks to...
programme.desc: Mark Lawson talks to legendary broadcaster Terry Wogan about his life and 50-year career. In this thoughtful interview Terry explores his early years growing up in Ireland, recalls how the shaky beginnings of Irish television provided him with a great training ground for a career in live broadcast and talks about how, because of his gentle demeanour, he has eluded the censors more than any of his peers.

programme.title: Brian Cox: Seven Days on Mars
programme.desc: Professor Brian Cox fulfils a childhood dream by going behind the scenes at Nasa's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL), mission control for Mars 2020 - one of the most ambitious missions ever launched that may finally reveal if life ever existed on the red planet. In 1980, a young Brian Cox wrote to JPL asking for photos from some of their missions to the planets. The pictures they sent him from Voyager and the Viking mission to Mars were a source of inspiration.

programme.title: The Longest Goodbye
programme.desc: NASA intends to send astronauts to Mars. To succeed, crew members will have to overcome unprecedented, life-threatening challenges, and while many of these hazards are physical, the most elusive are psychological. Throughout the expected three-year absence, crew members won't be able to communicate with Earth in real time due to the immense distance.

programme.desc: Robb Stark's chain of victories against the Lannisters enrages Joffrey, who punishes Sansa for her brother's successes. Tyrion struggles to find a way to curb his nephew's cruel excesses and enlists Cersei's lover Lancel as an informant. Catelyn urges the Baratheon brothers to forgo their ambitions and unite against a common enemy, while across the Narrow Sea, Daenerys and her exhausted retinue arrive at the walled city of Qarth

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Ghost of Harrenhal
programme.sub-title: The Ghost of Harrenhal Season 2, Episode 5
programme.desc: Catelyn is forced to flee when the Baratheon brothers' rivalry comes to a bloody end, and Lord Baelish spots an opportunity to further his own ambitions. Tyrion discovers Joffrey is planning to use a secret weapon to defend his seat of power, and Theon sails for the Stony Shore to prove his worth as a Greyjoy. Arya receives a favour from the man she freed from Harrenhal, and the Night's Watch arrives at the Fist of the First Men to stem the advance of the wildling army

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Old Gods and the New
programme.sub-title: The Old Gods and the New Season 2, Episode 6
programme.desc: King Joffrey's tyrannical rule prompts the people of King's Landing to riot, with near devastating consequences for Sansa. Meanwhile, beyond the Wall, Qhorin gives Jon a chance to prove himself. and across the Narrow Sea, Daenerys' resolve strengthens as she vows to reclaim what she believes is rightfully hers. Fantasy drama, starring Emilia Clarke

programme.title: Game of Thrones: A Man Without Honour
programme.sub-title: A Man Without Honour Season 2, Episode 7
programme.desc: Theon's determination to prove his Ironborn status prompts him to embark on a hunt. Daenerys receives an invitation that could prove useful to her cause, and Jaime Lannister's fortunes appear to change after a meeting with a relative among Robb Stark's captives. Fantasy drama, starring Alfie Allen, Emilia Clarke and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Prince of Winterfell
programme.sub-title: The Prince of Winterfell Season 2, Episode 8
programme.desc: King in the North Robb Stark is incensed when he learns he has been betrayed by one of his closest friends, while his fugitive sister Arya calls in a debt, leaving mysterious convict Jaqen H'ghar with a difficult decision to make. Meanwhile, across the Narrow Sea, Daenerys is presented with a dilemma as she struggles to negotiate with the seemingly egalitarian lords of Qarth

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Blackwater
programme.desc: King Joffrey's days on the Iron Throne appear to be numbered as Stannis lays claim to his late brother Robert's realm with a naval assault on King's Landing. The realities of all-out war leave the young tyrant reeling, and it is left to his sharp-witted uncle Tyrion to launch a defensive strategy that could save his family and decide the fate of the seven battle-scarred kingdoms of Westeros. Jack Gleeson, Peter Dinklage and Stephen Dillane star in an episode written by George RR Martin, whose novels form the basis for the series

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Valar Morghulis
programme.desc: Theon Greyjoy stirs his men into action as Maester Luwin offers some final advice, Arya receives a gift from the mysterious Jaqen, and Daenerys summons the courage to enter the House of the Undying. Meanwhile, Jon proves his worth as a brother of the Night's Watch to Qhorin Halfhand. Fantasy drama, based on George RR Martin's Song of Ice and Fire novels, and starring Maisie Williams, Kit Harington and Alfie Allen

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Valar Dohaeris
programme.desc: In King's Landing, Sansa grows in confidence under the watchful eye of the Machiavellian Lord Baelish, while Tyrion is after his just reward for the part he played in the Battle of the Blackwater. In the far North, Jon Snow is brought before formidable wildling leader Mance Rayder (Ciaran Hinds) and attempts to earn the trust of the King-beyond-the-Wall. Across the Narrow Sea, Daenerys Targaryen arrives in Slaver's Bay with adviser Ser Jorah Mormont looking to form an army. Fantasy drama based on George RR Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire series of novels, starring Peter Dinklage, Emilia Clarke and Kit Harington

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Dark Wings, Dark Words
programme.sub-title: Dark Wings, Dark Words Season 3, Episode 2
programme.desc: In King's Landing, Shae sneaks into Tyrion's chamber to tell him Ros warned her about Baelish's interest in Sansa, who goes to tea with Margaery and her grandmother Lady Olenna and is encouraged to speak freely about Joffrey. Jaime passes the time by taunting his escort Brienne, Arya encounters outlaw group the Brotherhood Without Banners, while Lord Karstark makes Robb aware he no longer has faith in him. Fantasy drama, guest starring Diana Rigg

programme.title: True Detective
programme.desc: In the town of Ennis, Alaska, the eight men working at the Tsalal Arctic Research Station all disappear. Local police chief Liz Danvers leads the investigation, but state trooper Evangeline Navarro believes it may be linked to an unsolved murder. The return of the crime anthology, starring Jodie Foster and Kali Reis

programme.title: Under Salt Marsh
programme.desc: Former detective turned teacher Jackie Ellis discovers the body of 8-year-old pupil Cefin, seemingly drowned. The discovery sends shockwaves through the community, reviving the wounds of an unsolved case that rocked the town three years prior - the disappearance of Jackie's niece Nessa, which cost her career. Crime drama, starring Kelly Reilly and Rafe Spall

programme.title: Under Salt Marsh
programme.desc: A teacher who was a detective makes a shocking discovery that reopens the wounds of a cold case. Crime drama, starring Kelly Reilly and Rafe Spall

programme.title: Euphoria: The Trials and Tribulations of Trying to Pee While Depressed
programme.sub-title: The Trials and Tribulations of Trying to Pee While Depressed Season 1, Episode 7
programme.desc: Cassie seeks advice following the events at Halloween, Rue binge watches a reality television series, and Jules pays an old friend a visit

programme.title: Euphoria: And Salt the Earth Behind You
programme.sub-title: And Salt the Earth Behind You Season 1, Episode 8
programme.desc: Rue questions whether her relationship with Jules will last, Nate is confronted about his actions, and Cal makes a huge decision

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Walk of Punishment
programme.desc: Tyrion assumes new responsibilities, Jon is taken to the imposing Fist of the First Men, and Jaime strikes a deal with his captors. Meanwhile, Daenerys meets with the slavers as she moves to build an army. Fantasy drama, starring Peter Dinklage, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau and Emilia Clarke

programme.title: Game of Thrones: And Now His Watch Is Ended
programme.sub-title: And Now His Watch Is Ended Season 3, Episode 4
programme.desc: The men of the Night's Watch become increasingly hostile to Craster, and Arya is brought before the commander of the Brotherhood Without Banners. Across the Narrow Sea, Daenerys takes charge of her army of the Unsullied, while in King's Landing, Cersei tells her father that Margaery is manipulating Joffrey, and Varys meets his match when he talks to Lady Olenna. Fantasy drama based on George RR Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire series of novels, starring Maisie Williams, Conleth Hill and Emilia Clarke

programme.title: Urban Secrets
programme.desc: Alan Cumming heads across the Irish Sea to Dublin, where he succumbs to the city's famous charm and meets some of its most fascinating characters. On a journey that takes in an 18th-century pleasure house and a burlesque life-painting class, Alan also stops off in Temple Bar for a pint with singer Sharon Corr, unlocks a mystery in Ireland's oldest library and uncovers a stylish secret that lurks behind the steel shutters of an old lock-up

programme.title: Urban Secrets
programme.desc: Alan Cumming explores the history of Bristol, beginning by learning a grisly secret at the docks before meeting Mercury Prize-winning musician Roni Size to discuss life in the St Pauls and Stokes Croft areas of the city. He also explores the district of Clifton and visits a speakeasy-style bar

programme.title: Urban Secrets
programme.desc: Alan Cumming visits Liverpool, cutting through cliches about football and the Beatles to explore its less-celebrated treasures. Among his destinations are a 1930s banking building that has remained unaltered since closing in 2007, a well-appointed set of toilets and a recording studio hidden in a bar. He also discovers which former dictator once spent Christmas in the city

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Kissed by Fire
programme.desc: The Hound is judged by the gods, while Jaime receives a different form of justice at the hands of men. Robb is betrayed, Jon proves himself and Tyrion learns the true cost of a wedding. Fantasy drama, starring Richard Madden, Kit Harington and Peter Dinklage

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Climb
programme.desc: Lord Tywin plans strategic unions for the Lannisters, Melisandre visits the Riverlands and Robb weighs up a compromise to repair his alliance with House Frey. Roose Bolton decides what to do with Jaime, while Jon, Ygritte and the wildlings face a daunting climb. Fantasy drama, starring Charles Dance

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Bear and the Maiden Fair
programme.sub-title: The Bear and the Maiden Fair Season 3, Episode 7
programme.desc: In King's Landing, Sansa frets about her prospects, Tyrion's new situation agitates Shae, and Tywin counsels the king. Daenerys exchanges gifts with a slave lord outside Yunkai, Melisandre reveals a secret to Robert Baratheon's illegitimate son Gendry, and Brienne faces a formidable foe at Harrenhal. Emilia Clarke and Peter Dinklage star in an episode written by George RR Martin, whose novels form the basis for the series

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Second Sons
programme.desc: Daenerys and her entourage discover Yunkai's 'powerful friends' are the Second Sons, an elite army of mercenaries. Determined to take the city and increase the strength of her own forces, the queen agrees to meet the sellsword company's captains - intending to make them a better offer. Meanwhile, Davos is still desperate to make Stannis see clearly and demands to see proof of Melisandre's power. There is a wedding in King's Landing, and beyond the Wall, Sam and Gilly have a chilling encounter with a foe that seems to have come straight from their nightmares. Fantasy drama, starring Emilia Clarke and Liam Cunningham

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Rains of Castamere
programme.sub-title: The Rains of Castamere Season 3, Episode 9
programme.desc: Robb and his bannermen gather at the Twins in the northern Riverlands to attend the wedding of Lord Edmure Tully and Roslin Frey, daughter of Lord Walder. Elsewhere, Jon faces his harshest test to date, Daario and Ser Jorah debate how to take Yunkai, and Bran discovers a new gift. Fantasy drama based on George RR Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire novels, starring Richard Madden, Michelle Fairley and David Bradley

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Mhysa
programme.desc: The various warring factions of Westeros receive news of the events of the wedding at the Twins. In King's Landing, Joffrey stands up to his grandfather Tywin, Daenerys discovers whether she'll be remembered as a conqueror or a liberator in Yunkai, and mercy comes from a surprising source in Dragonstone. Fantasy drama, starring Emilia Clarke, Charles Dance and Jack Gleeson

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Two Swords
programme.desc: Tyrion is sent out to welcome a royal party from Dorne outside the walls of King's Landing, and Jon Snow finds himself on trial at Castle Black over his time with the wildlings and the death of Qhorin Halfhand. Daenerys heads toward the slave city of Meereen, and Arya runs into a familiar face. Fantasy drama, starring Peter Dinklage, Emilia Clarke and Kit Harington

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Lion and the Rose
programme.sub-title: The Lion and the Rose Season 4, Episode 2
programme.desc: In King's Landing, the day of King Joffrey's wedding to Margaery Tyrell arrives, and while the sadistic monarch delights in tormenting his uncle Tyrion, the capital's various factions plot further alliances. However, all attention is drawn back to Joffrey following the arrival of a pie filled with live birds. Meanwhile, Melisandre oversees a sacrifice to the Lord of Light at Dragonstone as three traitors are burned at the stake, and the future continues to look grim for Theon as Ramsay Snow finds a use for him. North of the Wall, Bran sees clearly where he and his friends must go after experiencing a series of visions

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Breaker of Chains
programme.desc: Ser Dontos spirits Sansa out of King's Landing and rows her out to a waiting ship, and Pod gives Tyrion news of his forthcoming trial. Tywin counsels Tommen on what makes a good king and also has an offer for Oberyn Martell. Sam decides Castle Black is not a safe places for Gilly, while Jon proposes a bold plan after the wildlings send a chilling message. Across the Narrow Sea, Daenerys picks a champion to take on the best that Meereen has to offer and Davos has an idea about raising funds for Stannis's cause

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Oathkeeper
programme.desc: In King's Landing, Jaime finally visits Tyrion in jail after some persuasion from Bronn, and he also has a mission for Brienne. Daenerys tries to balance justice and mercy in Meereen. At Castle Black, Jon asks for volunteers when Ser Alliser decides to let him go to Craster's Keep to deal with the mutineers. Fantasy drama, starring Emilia Clarke, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau and Kit Harrington

programme.title: Game of Thrones: First of His Name
programme.sub-title: First of His Name Season 4, Episode 5
programme.desc: In King's Landing, Cersei and Tywin plot the next move for the Lannisters and the Crown after Tommen's coronation, while Ser Jorah gives Daenerys worrying news about the situations in Yunkai and Astapor. Jon and his band of volunteers mount a raid on the mutineers at Craster's Keep, and Sansa and Littlefinger arrive at the Eyrie. Fantasy drama, starring Lena Headey, Charles Dance, Emilia Clarke and Kit Harington

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Laws of Gods and Men
programme.sub-title: The Laws of Gods and Men Season 4, Episode 6
programme.desc: Stannis and Davos arrive in Braavos for their meeting with the Iron Bank, but find Tycho Nestoris (Mark Gatiss) a hard man to do business with. Yara Greyjoy leads a band of Ironborn on a mission to rescue her brother Theon, while Daenerys meets with supplicants in Meereen. In King's Landing, Tyrion's trial begins in the throne room and he is stunned by the identity of one of the crown's witnesses. Fantasy drama, starring Stephen Dillane and Peter Dinklage

programme.title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms: Hard Salt Beef
programme.desc: Dunk appeals to various lords in order to gain entrance into the tournament,.but Egg advises him to hold onto his pride. When the Targaryens arrive at Ashford, Dunk seizes his moment with Prince Baelor

programme.title: Task: Family Statements
programme.desc: As he prepares for an emotional court appearance, Tom buries himself in the case, while Emily questions her obligations to the family. Maeve makes a critical choice to protect her own loved ones, while Robbie works to find a way to turn his newfound surplus into cash

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Mockingbird
programme.desc: Tyrion enlists an unlikely ally, while Daario entreats Daenerys to allow him to do what he does best. Jon's warnings about the Wall's vulnerability fall on deaf ears, while Brienne and Pod follow a new lead as they continues their mission to track down the Stark girls. Fantasy drama, starring Peter Dinklage, Kit Harington and Emilia Clarke

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Mountain and the Viper
programme.sub-title: The Mountain and the Viper Season 4, Episode 8
programme.desc: Tyrion's fate is decided as his champion Oberyn Martell faces against Gregor 'the Mountain' Clegane in his trial by combat, while Mole's Town is on the receiving end of a raid by the wildlings. Ramsay sends Theon into Moat Cailin to negotiate the surrender of the Ironborn troops holding the fort, Littlefinger and Sansa are questioned about the circumstances surrounding Lysa's death and Barristan confronts Jorah about a document delivered to him. Fantasy drama, starring Peter Dinklage and Pedro Pascal

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Watchers on the Wall
programme.sub-title: The Watchers on the Wall Season 4, Episode 9
programme.desc: The men of the Night's Watch face their biggest challenge yet as they prepare to defend the Wall and Castle Black against attacks from the north and south by Mance Rayder's wildling army, with Ygritte determined to be the one to kill Jon Snow. Sam gets some sage advice about love from Maester Aemon and is shocked when someone comes knocking at the gates seeking shelter. Fantasy drama, starring Kit Harington and directed by Neil Marshall, the man behind the second series episode depicting the Battle of the Blackwater

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Children
programme.desc: Jon Snow heads into the wildling camp to try to negotiate a peace with Mance Rayder, but an unexpected arrival changes the situation at the Wall, while Daenerys is forced to make a decision about the dragons in Meereen. Cersei demands that Tywin call off her engagement to Loras Tyrell, Bran learns more about his destiny, and Tyrion receives a visit from Jaime as he awaits his fate. Fantasy drama based on George RR Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire series of novels, starring Peter Dinklage and Emilia Clarke

programme.title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms: The Squire
programme.desc: After Egg attempts to train Dunk's stubborn horse, the knight teaches his new squire an important skill. As they take in the tourney's first full day of events, Dunk receives a proposition from the Ashford steward that could help secure his future

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Last of the Starks
programme.sub-title: The Last of the Starks Season 8, Episode 4
programme.desc: After the Battle of Winterfell, the Great War to gain control over the mythical land of Westeros continues as Jon and Daenerys look to the south. Meanwhile, Jon shares a secret with his siblings. Starring Emilia Clarke, Kit Harington and Peter Dinklage

programme.title: Urban Secrets
programme.desc: Alan Cumming visits Glasgow, one of his favourite cities, to reveal unusual and often hidden sights and sounds overlooked by the public. Starting at the Necropolis, he travels to the world's oldest music hall before enjoying the views from a city-centre landmark. He also finds the time to take tea with a film star

programme.title: The Guest Wing
programme.desc: Documentary following stately home owners who hire out their estates to earn extra income, and the clients who pay to use their properties for functions including stag parties, weddings and hunting trips. The programme explores how the reality of life in Britain's grand houses is often less glamorous than it appears, as proprietors struggle to maintain crumbling buildings and pay utility bills, and examines the modern-day divide between domestic staff and their employers. Featuring life at Chillingham Castle, Maunsel House, Carlton Towers and Muncaster Castle

programme.title: The Guest Wing
programme.desc: Lord and Lady Fitzalan Howard, the owners of Carlton Towers near Selby in North Yorkshire, prepare to host a fitness boot camp weekend at their property - while also welcoming an array of guests to celebrate their son's birthday. Meanwhile, Sir Benjamin Slade hopes a murder mystery weekend at Maunsel House in Somerset will help pay off a sizeable electricity bill

programme.title: Boardwalk Empire: Erlkonig
programme.desc: Nucky heads to Philadelphia to deal with the fallout from Willie Thompson's recent liquor fiasco, but it becomes clear Henry's parents are powerful people and determined to get answers about the death of their son. Meanwhile, Kessler is detained by Agent Knox, who uses physical and psychological tactics to elicit information about Nucky's organisation, while Gillian's life continues to spiral out of control as her heroin addiction leads her to take desperate measures. In Cicero, Van Alden is recruited by the Capones to pay an election-day visit to local factory workers

programme.title: Boardwalk Empire: The North Star
programme.desc: After a cautious reunion with Margaret in New York City, Nucky heads to Tampa to work out the details of his investment with Bill McCoy and reconnects with speakeasy owner Sally Wheet. Meyer Lansky decides to go it alone on his land deal when Lucky Luciano gets spooked by an investor with ties to Joe Masseria. In Atlantic City, Harrow returns from exile and makes a confession to ailing war veteran Sagorsky, Chalky takes his frustrations out on Daughter, and Knox finds a new way to gain Eli's trust

programme.title: The Sopranos: No Show
programme.desc: Christopher gets off to a bad start with Patsy, Meadow contemplates taking a year off college to travel around Europe and Tony warns Janice about her new love. Meanwhile, there are problems on the horizon at the Newark construction site and Adriana abruptly ends her friendship with Danielle. Crime drama, starring James Gandolfini, Lorraine Bracco and Edie Falco

programme.title: The Sopranos: Christopher
programme.desc: Silvio and Ralph try to ensure the Columbus Day parade takes place without any problems, Father Phil hosts an Italian Pride ladies' lunch, and Bobby's wife Karen is involved in a car accident. Meanwhile, Tony reflects on the importance of good role models. Starring James Gandolfini, Lorraine Bracco and Edie Falco

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Wars to Come
programme.sub-title: The Wars to Come Season 5, Episode 1
programme.desc: At Castle Black, Jon Snow struggles to mediate between wildling leader Mance Rayder and Stannis Baratheon, while a mournful Cersei continues to worry about the future of her son Tommen in King's Landing. Tyrion arrives in a new location and is presented with a fresh opportunity and Daenerys grapples with the politics of power in Meereen, as well as her tempestuous dragons. Starring Kit Harington, Lena Headey, Peter Dinklage and Emilia Clarke

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The House of Black and White
programme.sub-title: The House of Black and White Season 5, Episode 2
programme.desc: Arya arrives in Braavos, while Brienne and Pod run into trouble on the road, and Cersei fears for her daughter's safety in Dorne as Ellaria Sand seeks revenge for her lover Oberyn's death. Stannis has a proposal for Jon and an advisor tempts Daenerys. Fantasy drama, starring Maisie Williams, Lena Headey and Emilia Clarke

programme.title: The Wire: Soft Eyes
programme.desc: Herc catches Royce in a compromising situation, and Carcetti drops a bombshell on his rival during a televised mayoral debate. While Prez prepares for the start of term, Marlo gives the neighbourhood children money for school equipment and Michael catches his attention by refusing the handout. Bunk finds a murder suspect hard to track down and Bubbles trains an apprentice

programme.title: The Wire: Home Rooms
programme.desc: Royce tries to reverse his ailing fortunes in the polls by taking drastic action against Carcetti, while the new head of the Major Case Unit is not to Freamon and Greggs' liking. The newly domesticated McNulty invites Bunk to dinner with him and Beadie, while Colvin considers an offer to help an academic research violent behaviour. Prez has a rough first day of teaching and Michael impresses Bodie and Marlo

programme.title: Westworld: Parce Domine
programme.desc: As the third series of the sci-fi drama unfolds, the critical event that marked the end of the last season threatens to consume the outside world. Dolores develops a relationship with Caleb, and comes to learn how artificial beings are treated in the real world. Starring Evan Rachel Wood, Aaron Paul and Vincent Cassel

programme.title: Deadwood: Amalgamation and Capital
programme.desc: Swearengen strikes a departure deal with Miss Isringhausen and orders Farnum to befriend Blasanov so he can monitor any telegrams coming in from Yankton. Bullock gains possession of a safe full of money, while Hostetler and the General acquire a valuable wild horse they hope to sell to the cavalry. Drama, starring Ian McShane and Timothy Olyphant

programme.desc: After Dina shares crucial intelligence information, Ellie prepares to petition the town council. Near Seattle, a religious group flees a war. Post-apocalyptic drama, starring Bella Ramsey

programme.title: The Sopranos: For All Debts Public and Private
programme.sub-title: For All Debts Public and Private Season 4, Episode 1
programme.desc: Tony invests in a potentially lucrative land deal, but Carmela has doubts about the family's long-term financial security. Meanwhile, Adriana confides in her new friend Danielle, unaware she is an undercover FBI agent, and Christopher resolves to avenge an old murder. James Gandolfini and Michael Imperioli star

programme.title: The Lawnmower Man
programme.desc: Visually arresting thriller about a researcher who uses a mentally disabled gardener for ill-advised experiments in inducing mental development through virtual reality simulations. At first, the simulations seem to enhance the lawnmower man's mental powers, but then the experiment goes haywire. Based on a short story by Stephen King.

programme.title: Black Hawk Down
programme.desc: Based on the botched mission during America's military involvement in Somalia in the early 1990s. An attempt by US Army Rangers parachuted into Mogadishu to capture a warlord's two top lieutenants goes disastrously wrong when two helicopters are shot down.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: As war with the Transformers rages on, inventor Cade Yeager forms an unlikely alliance with Bumblebee, an English lord and an Oxford professor to save the planet.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Jurassic
programme.desc: Welcome to a Cinema List 65 million years in the making, going through the very best moments from the Jurassic franchise - from the 1993 original to `Jurassic World: Dominion'.
